title: How a Sink P-Trap Protects Your Home
description: A sink P-trap operates on simple hydraulic principles to separate living areas from municipal drainage systems. As wastewater enters the sink drain, gravity pushes liquid down through the inlet dip and up out the outlet weir into the wall branch. When the flow stops, a portion of clean water remains trapped in the lower dip of the pipe. This trapped water creates an airtight seal that prevents sewer gases, insects, and foul odors from rising out of the drain. Proper pipe alignment and correct slope ensure wastewater flows smoothly without siphoning out the necessary standing seal.

This trapped water creates an airtight seal that prevents sewer gases, insects, and foul odors from rising out of the drain. Proper pipe alignment and correct slope ensure wastewater flows smoothly without siphoning out the necessary standing seal.
